head: b27fc19bc

environment.gpu: AMD Radeon integrated graphics (RADV RENOIR), amdgpu DPM 200/400/2000 MHz
environment.method: halcyon.service stopped; release build run with DESKTOP_CARDS_CONFIG and XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME pointing at temporary copies; the service was started again by the same bounded command, including on failure. The user's config was never written.

screenshots.kept: Private scratch only; they show the owner's open windows.
screenshots.effects: Rain (Flowing and Merging), Snow, Fog and Cloud shadows all render behind windows and widgets. Cloud shadows confirmed with a difference image against the effect-off baseline.
screenshots.clock: No clipped Clock text in any capture: the owner's Clock (bold digital, 200%, 800x330), the same Clock moved clear of windows, and a 540x220 Clock across a minute rollover, each with rain, fog or no effect.

pauses.speed_zero: Snow at 0% speed: two captures 11 s apart are pixel-identical; 0 ns GPU over 10 s.
pauses.reduce_motion: Effect surface removed; capture matches the effect-off baseline outside changed text; 0 ns GPU over 10 s; motion back resumes.
pauses.lock_sleep_battery: Private fake logind/UPower on a separate bus (DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS for the test process only; the real session was not locked). LockedHint, PrepareForSleep and OnBattery each stopped drawing (0 ns GPU, clean wallpaper); unlock, wake and Pause on battery off each resumed at 30 fps.

gpu.source: /proc/<pid>/fdinfo drm-engine-gfx, summed over unique drm-client-id, for halcyon and cosmic-comp
gpu.note: Busy time, not timestamps: at 30 fps amdgpu mostly sits at 400 MHz, so per-frame busy time is higher than at full clock. Includes all Halcyon surfaces. Not comparable one-to-one with the 4K pass timestamps in WALLPAPER-EFFECTS.md.

cases_ms_per_second.case: Locked / preparing for sleep / on battery

nested_clipping: Not reproduced on the real desktop and no EGL errors were logged by the app. Xvfb is no longer installed, so the nested run could not be repeated; the earlier observation is attributed to the nested compositor's EGL surface failures.
limits: One 1080p output. No multi-monitor, HiDPI, battery-powered device, energy or packaged-artifact qualification. Not a release.
